rule: A capability is complete only when a workflow, an implementation or a verifiable output exists. A markdown rule on its own is 'partial'.

capabilities.rationale: Upstream states the principle in prose. SiteSmith produces EVIDENCE.md per project with seven required sections and an inferred/needed marker convention the production gate reads.

SiteSmith records a signature in DIRECTION.md but until direction-fidelity gained signature-selector there was no way to show the signature existed on the page. The selector is now required and none of the three pilots declares one.
capabilities.evidence: P0-2 — all three pilots currently FAIL on 'names no signature-selector'

capabilities.rationale: No competitor requires or measures three structurally different comps. SiteSmith requires pairwise difference on three of five axes including composition, verified against the rendered DOM.
capabilities.evidence: tools/gate-fixtures.mjs — 4 direction fixtures including palette-variants FAIL

capabilities.rationale: taste-skill's dials govern density, motion and boldness explicitly. SiteSmith's mode files state outcomes but expose no dial the user can turn, so variation between projects depends entirely on the direction lab.
capabilities.licence: MIT, attributed in NOTICE.md; principle adapted, text not copied

capabilities.rationale: Upstream states anti-slop as guidance. SiteSmith keeps one append-only cross-project history storing the measured render fingerprint beside the declared axes, so a direction described in fresh words that renders as the last one is caught.

SiteSmith has an asset manifest but no step that inventories an existing brand — extracting palette from a supplied logo, recording type, and building a reference board. A CEO with an existing brand cannot hand it over.
ASSET-MANIFEST.md records id, source, licence, state, focal point and treatment; the production gate fails a build with any row not ready, an unmanifested asset, or an empty element used as a mark.
'ready' means technically present. direction-fidelity now measures asset share of the first screen against what the declared imagery commits to, and all three pilots fail it (2.06 %, 4.47 %, 0.55 %).

Vendored under MIT and kept, but deliberately demoted: SiteSmith writes the contract from the winning comp rather than generating it from a query, because generating tokens before a direction is chosen is the mechanism that made nine subjects converge.
capabilities.evidence: token-drift.mjs PASS on all three pilots, 0 undeclared values
capabilities.licence: MIT, © Next Level Builder, attributed in NOTICE.md

capabilities.rationale: Upstream returns the top three by BM25, which are near each other by construction. SiteSmith adds --candidates: three deliberately contrasting rows with confidence, the near-misses they displaced and cross-project anti-repeat.
capabilities.licence: MIT base vendored and attributed; selection logic original

capabilities.rationale: SiteSmith vendors the 25 stack CSVs but its pipeline never routes to them. The mode files are stack-agnostic and blocks are plain HTML, so a Next.js or Astro project gets generic guidance. Demoted to P1 for v1.0: no exit gate depends on it, because the pilots and all three benchmark briefs are plain HTML and CSS.
capabilities.evidence: none — no step reads a stack

capabilities.rationale: impeccable's live mode edits a running page; it does not assert that a state is reachable. SiteSmith requires a Playwright journey per surface asserting a change, an announcement, a failure path and a keyboard path.
capabilities.evidence: 3 journey fixtures; a painted-state page fails, a wired one passes

capabilities.rationale: verify.mjs renders at three widths, runs axe in both colour schemes, and checks overflow, dead links, console errors, document structure and wide-font stress.
capabilities.evidence: CI: nine benchmarks, the block harness and the gallery; the control must keep failing

capabilities.rationale: SiteSmith has tools/conformance.mjs with a ratchet, but it is text-level and runs over files rather than a rendered page. impeccable's detector runs in the browser against computed style.
capabilities.evidence: conformance baseline with 97 recorded violations and a ratchet
capabilities.licence: Apache-2.0; implement independently, do not lift rules

capabilities.rationale: impeccable documents critique as a command. SiteSmith enforces the ceremony: two locked reviews, hashes of brief, rubric and sheets, an opaque label, key opened after both locks, whole-review generic scanning, and reviewer ≠ builder.

SiteSmith has nine scripts and a thirteen-step prose process but no named commands. A user cannot say 'audit this' or 'polish that'. impeccable declares its vocabulary as data so providers can be generated from it.
capabilities.licence: Apache-2.0; the idea of metadata-as-data is adopted, the file is not copied

capabilities.rationale: All three competitors install in one command. SiteSmith is cloned by hand. There is no update path and nothing detects a broken or drifted installation.
impeccable ships three provider trees generated from one source with a lock file. SiteSmith ships a Claude skill directory only.

A live browser session that injects into a running dev server, stores sessions, applies manual edits and commits them is a product in itself — ~17 modules plus adapters for Svelte, SvelteKit and TanStack. It does not serve the closed loop SiteSmith is claiming, and building a worse version of it before v1.0 would cost the release. Revisit after v1.0.
SiteSmith has references/06-redesign-audit.md and a REDESIGN route, but the v2 pipeline is written for a new build; there is no step that inventories an existing component library and reuses it.
capabilities.licence: original (upstream redesign-skill was removed for unverifiable provenance)

capabilities.rationale: No competitor benchmarks its own effect. SiteSmith has the harness — pinned base digest, internal network, exact-host egress proxy, two gates, 63 self-tests — but has not run the 18 generations, so the claim is unproven.
capabilities.evidence: 63 runner self-tests pass; probe and generations not yet run

capabilities.rationale: Mode E and the pilot enforce honest figures by convention — the chandlery publishes batch numbers and refuses to state a safe working load. Nothing mechanical stops a build inventing a price, a review or a delivery promise.
capabilities.evidence: production-gate blocks fabricated-proof language and stand-in identifiers; no check for invented commerce facts
